scope: Key workflow illustrations per class; not a screenshot of every step.

assets.title: Create the lab.example.test forest
assets.note: Example: AG-DC01 creates lab.example.test. Replica DCs join the existing domain; DEST-DC01 creates its separate forest. Never choose a new forest for AG-DC02.
assets.provenance: AI-adapted Microsoft AD DS wizard reference, with lab-specific domain and server labels. Not a Server 2019 capture.

assets.title: Install, back up, and restore SQL Server
assets.note: The sheet combines several SQL screens for orientation. Exact installer pages vary. Use SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS where the lesson requires it. Restore tests must use separate database and data-file names.
assets.provenance: AI-generated schematic training illustration; software layouts are representative, not exact captures.

assets.title: Build the Azure destination and upgrade its OS
assets.note: The example is the Windows APP01 → APP02 route. Provision APP02 as Server 2019 first; use upgrade-01 for its later 2022 upgrade. Private connectivity and DNS must pass before copying data. This is a workload migration, not a Workstation VM rehost.
assets.provenance: AI-generated schematic training illustration; software layouts are representative, not exact captures.

assets.title: Use SSH, inspect RHEL, and verify a file transfer
assets.note: Commands shown are examples, not output. Use the host, user, key path, and test file from this lesson. Run PowerShell commands on Windows and Bash commands inside RHEL.
assets.provenance: AI-generated schematic training illustration; software layouts are representative, not exact captures.

assets.title: Prepare the MECM dependencies

assets.provenance: AI-generated schematic training illustration; software layouts are representative, not exact captures.

assets.title: Plan SQL quorum and the cloud witness
assets.note: The cloud witness is Azure Storage, not a third SQL VM. A quorum witness does not replicate databases or make an application highly available by itself.
assets.provenance: AI-generated schematic training illustration; software layouts are representative, not exact captures.

assets.title: Connect and inspect a Wazuh agent
assets.note: Replace MANAGER_PRIVATE_IP with your approved manager address. Discover your installed service names and verify your own dashboard record; the illustration contains no live agent telemetry.
assets.provenance: AI-generated schematic training illustration; software layouts are representative, not exact captures.

assets.title: Install Server 2019 and configure its network
assets.note: The panels combine separate wizard pages for orientation. Select Server 2019 Desktop Experience, then use this lesson’s exact VM name, RAM, disk, private IP, and DNS settings.

assets.note: DC01 10.50.0.10/24 and DC02 10.50.0.11/24 use host-only VMnet2. DHCP is off and the default gateway stays blank. The Windows host adapter can access the lab; there is no routed physical-LAN or internet connection.
